inlines.v: DIVINER, noun 1. One who professes divination; one who pretends to predict events, or to reveal occult things, by the aid of superior beings, or of supernatural means. These nations hearkened to diviners. Deuteronomy 18:14. 2. One who guesses; a conjecturer.
